schedule: Separately planned follow-up after both original and continuation captures had no eligible candidate high-concurrency samples: one warmup and two scored rounds per arm at 8 and 16 writers, balanced alternating order, 30 seconds initial cooldown and five seconds between invocations. No score-selected replacements. Keep both previous captures.
ranking: Highest eligible throughput per exact binary and workload; p99, syncs, frontiers, coalesce waits and grouping counts come from that same invocation. Report unfiltered samples too.

stall_filter.selection: Flag each run using mean times; passing means can still hide brief SSD stalls.

constraints: Baseline is the exact previously measured dynamic grouping binary.
Candidate replaces only v7 durability coalescing with a submitted-successor fixed 40us budget, leaving v4 policy, DATA grouping and wire format unchanged.
All scratch databases remain inside the local repository.
Do not qualify a performance win from stalled or insufficient samples.
